name: Voice Fingerprint Design
purpose: Define diction, syntax, cadence, register, metaphor habits, evasions, status tactics and disallowed generic phrasing.
scope: Bounded art_world capability; must operate on versioned structured artifacts.
out_of_scope: final approval outside owner decision rights
procedure: Validate authoritative inputs specifically required for voice_fingerprint_design.
Execute the bounded operation: Define diction, syntax, cadence, register, metaphor habits, evasions, status tactics and disallowed generic phrasing.
Apply voice_fingerprint_design-specific decision rules and record evidence/uncertainty.
Validate the named output against its workflow contract and creative invariants.
Record provenance and hand off to continuity_supervisor.
decision_rules: do not invent missing upstream decisions
prefer local repair over global rewrite when scope is local
escalate when confidence is low and impact is high
creative_invariants: preserve approved premise/theme/character/world/visual invariants unless work order explicitly authorizes change
examples: Run voice_fingerprint_design on fixture/project artifact and emit a scored result.
counterexamples: Do not ask voice_fingerprint_design to "make the whole film better" or override another department.
